description: This PHP source file defines the CustomFieldAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing custom fields in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting custom fields, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing custom fields, including retrieval, listing, creation, update, and deletion operations with validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field by its ID, returning a CustomFieldModel instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all custom fields with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom field, enforcing a maximum of 10 fields.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field specified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple custom fields by their IDs, ensuring none are in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for listing custom fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a custom field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting custom fields.

methods.name: setCustomField
methods.description: Assigns values to a CustomField object from request parameters.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Persists a CustomField object via the service layer.
